messages:
Maya: quick async standup — what I did: kicked prewarm for the tilt release, drained 4 nodes in us-west1 to test canary, validated model cache priming for v2 models. blockers: saw a small spike in latency during drain (p99 up ~200ms) and a couple spot evictions bounced capacity. today: opening a quota bump request for us-west1 and eu-west1, will coordinate canary with Jason.
Alex: noted — can you paste the prewarm command you ran? curious if we can reduce burst to avoid eviction churn. also can you share the p99 graph link?
Maya: prewarm command was: ```./scripts/prewarm.sh --region us-west1 --pool tilt-v2 --concurrency 8``` p99 graph: <https://grafana.redwood.local/d/tilt/p99?orgId=1&from=now-1h|tilt p99 last hour>
Priya: update on quotas: I filed tkt-4872 for +12 GPUs in us-west1 and tkt-4873 for +8 in eu-west1 this morning. cloud team acknowledged, ETA ~6-8h for review. I added justification + expected steady-state usage.
Jason: cool — I'll hold the canary rollout until Priya confirms quota or we throttle prewarm. also pinged on the autoscaler PR #662 (small change: reduce maxBatchSize from 64 -> 48) for review. low-risk but want it merged before wide canary.
infra-bot: snapshot (auto): ```us-west1: 44/48 (91%)
eu-west1: 22/32 (69%)
ap-northeast1: 7/16 (44%)
spot_eviction_rate_1h: 3.8%
queue_depth: 120 -> 160 (last 30m)```
Alex: thanks infra-bot. plan: I'll temporarily drain 2 low-util lanes and shift some prewarm to eu-west1 to absorb. Maya — can you run a quick sanity check after I shift? command: ```kubectl get pods -l pool=tilt-v2 -o wide --region us-west1```
Maya: yep will run after you shift. also opened a fallback policy to route to dedicated-tilt if queue >180.
Priya: quota update: cloud approved partial for eu-west1 +6 GPUs (tkt-4873 updated). us-west1 still pending. I requested expedited review for the remaining 6.
Jason: ok holding canary. I'll also back out the nonessential perf test scheduled at 15:00 to reduce noise.
Maya: appreciated. blockers cleared for now but keeping an eye on evictions. Alex — let me know when shift is done and I'll validate p99 and KV cache hit rate.
Alex: shifting now, will report in ~6m.
infra-bot: action log: Alex moved 8 prewarm jobs -> eu-west1 at 1729003000, autoscaler PR #662 pending review.
Maya: perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
